2114724573174198462.en_summary: @DanielTNiles, replying to @GarageIdol, argues the busts after massive industrial investment cycles benefit humanity: overinvestment in canals, railways and highways cut transport costs and unified markets, the internet bust's cheap bandwidth helped companies like $AMZN, $GOOGL, $META and $NFLX, and fracking overinvestment brought energy independence.
2114724573174198462.zh_summary: @DanielTNiles 回覆 @GarageIdol，認為大型產業投資週期之後的泡沫爆破對人類有益：運河、鐵路與高速公路的過度投資降低了運輸成本並統一了全國市場；互聯網泡沫後的廉價頻寬造就了 $AMZN、$GOOGL、$META 與 $NFLX 等公司；頁岩油過度投資則帶來能源獨立。
2114724573174198462.ko_summary: @DanielTNiles는 @GarageIdol에게 답글로, 대규모 산업 투자 사이클 이후의 붕괴가 인류에 이롭다고 주장합니다. 운하, 철도, 고속도로 과잉투자는 운송비를 낮추고 전국 시장을 통합했고, 인터넷 버블 붕괴 후의 값싼 대역폭은 $AMZN, $GOOGL, $META, $NFLX 같은 기업에 도움이 됐으며, 셰일 과잉투자는 에너지 자립을 가져왔다는 것입니다.

2114724608884478329.en_summary: @ripster47 says $RBRK is now up over 170% from the 50 level he mentioned, calling it one of the highest conviction SaaS names in his research, and says during selloffs one should check whether the fundamentals changed; here they were improving. The quoted earlier post said he was watching $RBRK for re-entry with the last trade's entry at 50 and risk at 48.
